claim: Commercial VPS hosting inside Uzbekistan is available from several providers: Airnet lists VPS plans in a Tier III Tashkent data center from about 200,000 UZS a month (for example 4 cores, 4 GB RAM, 75 GB SSD at 250,000 UZS), and Ahost lists virtual servers in the TAS-IX network with SSD options from about 125,000 UZS a month. Prices are from provider pages via search summaries and were not confirmed by ordering.
